mainDifference.question: What's the main difference between Focuspilot and Programa?
mainDifference.answer: Focuspilot is built for interior design studios worldwide with native Xero and QuickBooks integration, Stripe payments, and AI-powered features like email drafting and product sourcing. studioSize.answer: Focuspilot scales from solo designers to 50+ person studios. Our pricing model (£49/user for first 5, then £39/user) is designed for growing teams. Programa's per-project pricing can become expensive for studios managing many concurrent projects.

mainDifference.question: How is Focuspilot different from Design Manager?
mainDifference.answer: Focuspilot is a modern, cloud-native platform built for today's design studios. Unlike Design Manager's legacy desktop software, Focuspilot offers AI-powered features, real-time collaboration, mobile access, and integrated client payments. It's designed for studios who want modern tools without the complexity of traditional software.

largeStudios.question: Is Design Manager better for larger studios?
largeStudios.answer: Design Manager has historically served larger studios, but Focuspilot scales effectively from solo designers to 50+ person teams. Our AI features actually help smaller teams punch above their weight by automating admin tasks that would otherwise require additional staff.

mobile.question: Can I access Focuspilot on mobile?
mobile.answer: Yes. Focuspilot is fully responsive and works on any device with a browser. Your clients also get mobile-optimised portal access for approvals and payments. Design Manager requires desktop installation for full functionality.

accounting.question: Which has better accounting integration?
accounting.answer: Focuspilot has native two-way sync with Xero and QuickBooks, with automatic invoice and payment reconciliation. Design Manager supports accounting exports but requires more manual work to keep systems in sync.

commercial.question: Is Focuspilot suitable for commercial projects?
commercial.answer: Absolutely. While Focuspilot excels at residential projects, our procurement, approval, and financial tools handle commercial projects of any size. Multi-location projects, multiple stakeholder approvals, and complex budgeting are all supported.

support.question: What about training and support?
support.answer: Focuspilot is designed to be intuitive—most users are productive within hours, not weeks. We offer free onboarding calls, in-app guidance, and responsive support. Design Manager typically requires formal training sessions.
